title: Trash
intro: A deleted case stays here for {{days}} days, with its links and history, then it is erased.
confirmNoteBody: The case, its links and its history are permanently erased. This cannot be undone.
confirmAllBody_one: The case in the trash, its links and its history are permanently erased. This cannot be undone.
confirmAllBody_other: The {{count}} cases in the trash, their links and their history are permanently erased. This cannot be undone.
restoredWithSubCases_one: “{{title}}” and its sub-case are back in {{project}}.
restoredWithSubCases_other: “{{title}}” and its {{count}} sub-cases are back in {{project}}.
subCasesStay_one: Its sub-case stays in the trash.
subCasesStay_other: Its {{count}} sub-cases stay in the trash.
changedSinceShown: The trash changed since it was shown: check the number of cases, then confirm again.
